desc:
Welcome to Find the Mermaids! There are many different species of underwater life, and it's your job to find them all. Traverse different biomes, roleplay with your friends, become a princess of a kingdom, and so much more!

📝 Update Log
- Catalog fixes
- In-game Catalog 🧜‍♀️: Create the mermaid outfit of your dreams!
- Item wearing previews
- Undo and Redo feature for the catalog
- New GamePass for wearing any tail

🏆 Roblox Premium users will get radar that expands an additional 25%
🛡️ Group members of Primorra Games also get radar that expands an additional 25% (stacks with Premium)

🧜‍♀️There are currently 76 tails to be found
